title: Brown's experiments replicated worldwide, including in Japan

tellings.quote: They've been replicated all over the world in places as far as Japan

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that the experiments of a researcher named Thomas Townsend Brown, who worked on the idea that electricity could affect gravity, have been repeated all over the world, in places as far away as Japan. If true, it would mean Brown's results are not a one-off but something others can reproduce.
